## Source

`/trading212/t212-portfolio`

## Problem

No way to filter between All, Live, and Practice accounts on the Trading212 portfolio view.

## Expected

Add a clear toggle or tab bar with three options:
- **All** — show both Live and Practice positions
- **Live** — only real-money positions
- **Practice** — only practice account positions

The toggle should be prominent near the top of the view.
